title: Why Marriage and Family are the Best Options for Men
author: Martin, Chris
source: The Ways of a Gentleman, February 25, 2026
summary: Chris Martin argues that love is not meant to remain in perpetual romance but to move toward permanence and family. In a culture celebrating independence above all, he explains why marriage and family remain the natural destination of honorable love, with men discovering fulfillment through responsibility and binding commitment to another person.
points: Love must move beyond romance toward permanence and lasting commitment.
Courtship was preparation for lifelong marriage, not entertainment or casual romance.
Men who choose responsibility and family discover true fulfillment in life.
Marriage and family are natural destinations of honorable love, not relics of the past.
quotes: Love is not meant to remain suspended in perpetual romance or an endless cycle of casual relationships. Love is meant to move toward permanence, something that outlasts any of those overwhelming feelings of emotion we may feel early on in a relationship.
For generations, men instinctively understood this concept. Courtship was not entertainment; it was preparation for a lifelong relationship.

In a culture that seems to celebrate independence above everything else, the idea of binding oneself permanently to another person might seem odd to some men. Yet time and time again, the men who choose responsibility discover fulfillment in life.

Marriage and family are not relics of a bygone era. They are the natural destination of honorable love and they are worth seeking for all men.” Archived from The Ways of a Gentleman on May 2, 2026 by Tim.
